description: The file 'SoapDeprecated.php' contains PHP code that defines SOAP web service functions for interacting with SugarCRM/SuiteCRM entities such as contacts, leads, accounts, opportunities, cases, bugs, and emails. It includes registration of SOAP methods, user authentication, and CRUD operations, along with extensive inline documentation and legacy code handling. The file is marked as deprecated and provides low-level SOAP API interfaces for CRM data management.

classes.name: AuthenticationController
classes.description: Handles user authentication including login validation, potentially supporting legacy and encrypted passwords.

methods.name: create_session
methods.description: Creates a new user session after validating credentials.

methods.name: end_session
methods.description: Ends the user session for a given username.

methods.name: validate_user
methods.description: Validates user credentials using the User bean and possibly decrypts passwords.

methods.name: contact_by_email
methods.description: Retrieves contacts and associated linked objects matching email addresses.

methods.name: get_contact_relationships
methods.description: Fetches related modules and linked data for a specific contact record.

methods.name: user_list
methods.description: Returns a list of user details if the requester has access.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs comprehensive searches across multiple entities for given names.

methods.name: track_email
methods.description: Tracks email messages and links them to CRM records and contacts.

methods.name: create_contact
methods.description: Creates a new contact record with provided details after validation.

methods.name: create_lead
methods.description: Creates a new lead record with specified details after validation.

methods.name: create_account
methods.description: Creates a new account record after user validation.

methods.name: create_opportunity
methods.description: Creates an opportunity record post authentication.

methods.name: create_case
methods.description: Creates a case record after validating user credentials.
